steps.en: Hirers past the first reminder letter are picked for a message
steps.id: Hirer yang lewat surat reminder pertama dipilih untuk dikirimi pesan
steps.why_en: The first letter is assumed from the stage only; letter generation runs manually and the file upload to the printer is blocked.
steps.why_id: Surat pertama hanya diasumsikan dari tahap; pembuatan surat manual dan pengiriman file ke percetakan diblokir.

steps.en: Latest phone or email is fetched from the government data source
steps.id: Nomor HP atau email terbaru diambil dari sumber data pemerintah
steps.why_en: The refresh is switched off in all environments, so the contact already stored is used instead.
steps.why_id: Pengambilan data terbaru dimatikan di semua environment, jadi kontak yang sudah tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Hirers without a usable contact, opted out, or with a passport are skipped
steps.id: Hirer tanpa kontak yang bisa dipakai, opt-out, atau paspor dilewati

steps.en: The checks run on a daily schedule before messages go out
steps.id: Pengecekan berjalan terjadwal harian sebelum pesan dikirim
steps.why_en: The daily schedule is switched off in the production settings; the job only runs when someone triggers it by hand.
steps.why_id: Jadwal harian dimatikan di pengaturan produksi; job hanya jalan bila dipicu manual.
